sourceDate.text: 太祖即位前後至神冊三年
太祖為叠剌部夷離堇時

translationRepairs: As a child he roamed with Taizu, and Shilu, his uncle by marriage, remarked in wonder, "These two boys will be the ones to restore our house."
As a child he roamed with Taizu, and Shilu, his paternal uncle, remarked in wonder, "These two boys will be the ones to restore our house."
從父 denotes a paternal uncle (father's brother); "uncle by marriage" invents affinal kinship not present in the Chinese.
While still in childhood, he kept company with the Taizu; his uncle-by-marriage Shilu marveled at them and said: "Those who will raise up our house will surely be these two boys."
While still in childhood, he kept company with the Taizu; his paternal uncle Shilu marveled at them and said: "Those who will raise up our house will surely be these two boys."
The literal field likewise misreads 從父 as uncle-by-marriage; paternal uncle is the correct kinship term.
Once Bohai was pacified, it was reorganized as the Eastern Dande state.
Once Bohai was pacified, it was reorganized as the Eastern Dan state.
東丹國 is the Eastern Dan (Dongdan) state created from pacified Bohai; "Dande" is a false reading of 丹.
Once Bohai was pacified, it was reorganized as the Eastern Dande state.
Once Bohai was pacified, it was reorganized as the Eastern Dan state.
Literal must match idiomatic: 東丹國 is Eastern Dan, not Eastern Dande.
In the seventh month of the third year, when the imperial capital was completed, the ministers of Yan performed the completion rite.
In the seventh month of the third year, when the imperial capital was completed, [the emperor] banqueted the ministers to celebrate its completion.
燕群臣以落之 uses 燕 as the verb "to banquet" the ministers for the completion rite (落之), not the place name Yan.
In the seventh month of the third year, when the imperial capital was completed, the ministers of Yan performed the completion rite.
In the seventh month of the third year, when the imperial capital was completed, [he] banqueted the assembled ministers to celebrate its completion.
Literal likewise wrongly made 燕 a placename; 燕群臣 means to feast the assembled ministers, with 落之 marking the capital's completion.
When Taizu transferred the throne, Haili contributed force to it.
When the throne was transferred to Taizu, Haili contributed force to it.
Following 初受命 and Haili's allegiance to Taizu, 太祖傳位 is succession to Taizu, not Taizu abdicating the throne.
Later, when the Taizu matched his twenty-one meritorious ministers each to a bodily metaphor, Helu was likened to the heart cloud.
Later, when the Taizu matched his twenty-one meritorious ministers each to a bodily metaphor, Helu was likened to the heart.
In 以曷魯為心雲, 雲 is the classical sentence-final particle; Helu is likened to the heart, not a "heart cloud".
For this reason, among the Taizu's meritorious ministers he was likened to the hand cloud.
For this reason, among the Taizu's meritorious ministers he was likened to the hand.
喻以手雲 likewise ends with particle 雲; the bodily metaphor is the hand alone.
Xiao Dilu, whose style was Dilian, was born to Dezong's younger half-sister; Empress Chunqin was also his elder half-sister.
Xiao Dilu, whose style was Dilian, was born to Dezong's younger sister; Empress Chunqin was also his elder sister.
女弟 and 女兄 mean younger and elder sister; the Chinese does not mark half-sibship, so "half-sister" overtranslates.
